regions.label: INESHeader
regions.evidence: Parsed iNES header identifies 512 KiB PRG, 128 KiB CHR, MMC3, battery and mirroring; inspect agrees.

regions.label: CHRPatternROM
regions.evidence: Header-delimited CHR ROM is PPU pattern storage, separate from CPU executable PRG. Two 8-byte bit planes per 8x8 tile; no CPU ROM window maps this section.

regions.label: InterruptVectors
regions.evidence: Hardware NMI/reset/IRQ little-endian vectors $F5EE/$F5AC/$D85E at final six bytes of fixed PRG bank 63; reset confirmed by emulator initial PC.

Exact 64-entry permutation of physical 8 KiB indices0..63, followed immediately by independently decoded PHA/TXA/PHA CHR mapper routine at $FC16. See dispatch-inspection-rpc.jsonl and bank-table-rpc.jsonl. Structural table extent supported by complete finite bank domain, permutation and code boundary; selector natural domain not fully recovered.
